race.comment: HELLOFACURY (2) settled midfield and held that position through the line when fresh from a spell over 1100m at Ararat last start. Faces an easier maiden today and the longer trip suits. Great chance to open the account. CHALLENGING (1) ran the best race of his five to date last time out over 1400m at Echuca, beaten under a length after leading until the dying stages. Can cross from the wide alley and give them something to catch again. NATIVE DANCE (8) missed the kick and never really got involved on debut recently over 1200m at Warrnambool. Can learn a lot from that experience and in a moderate line-up she is in contention. UNCLAIMED (12) also blew his chances with a slow start on debut recently over 1200m at Swan Hill. Could be a big improver with blinkers going on for the first time. GUNNATIPPATINNIE (4) did a reasonable job to finish fourth on debut at Warrnambool last start. Can feature prominently with some natural improvement to come.
